mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies near Harriet Park and a lovely Full Moon tonight.

City engineering updates continue as the city contracts with AECOM for ongoing reports. Additionally, WisDOT is hosting meetings on November 18 and 19 regarding the US 18/151 Corridor Study, including initial design concepts for the stretch between Dodgeville and Fitchburg.

We have plenty of fun coming up in Verona. Trivia is happening today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, with Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's tomorrow. Plus, look forward to yoga tomorrow and the Main Street Trick or Treat this Thursday.
In a noteworthy call for service on October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds on eMotos, which resulted in citations for their parents for permitting a minor to drive a motor vehicle.
The Culver's flavor of the day is a tasty Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, so stop by before they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
